recipe.positive: Visual style (follow exactly): in the style of Monument Valley (ustwo games) isometric illustration. Isometric illustration: clean 30-degree isometric projection, crisp geometric shapes with soft flat shading on three faces, tidy miniature world, limited friendly palette (soft blue, coral, mint, warm white), no perspective distortion, clear and modern.
